review_scope: AST parsing, exact proposal/readset hashes and manual scope/preservation inspection; correlated review, no runtime or Lean acceptance
operational_premise: One exclusive quiet integration owner; all other writers paused. Existing-target hash check then os.replace is NOT an atomic conditional compare-and-swap against uncooperative concurrent writers. Whole multi-file operation is not atomic. New-page no-clobber link, per-file replacement and partial-state journal are bounded implementation mechanisms, not Lean-proved refinements.
remaining_owner_work: Review helper; wait native child exit, retire old queued application stage; owner alone installs, renders, generates current observation/contract and validates final combined snapshot; preserve all old receipts and failures.
